NOTE 2. To be valid, this proxy form must be duly completed and delivered to the registered office of
the Company not later than 11:00 on Monday 19 April 2004.
A member entitled to attend and vote at the meeting is entitled to appoint a proxy on his behalf. A
proxy need not be a member of the Company. To be valid, a form of proxy which is provided with
this report, must be duly completed by the member in proxy and must be lodged at the registered
office of the Company, 1st Floor, Bank House, Moi Avenue, Nairobi, or be posted, so as to reach the
Company not later than 11.00 on Monday 19 April 2004.
Any member may by notice duly signed by him and delivered to the registered office of the Company
not less than seven days and not more than 28 days before the day appointed for this meeting
propose any other person for election to the Board, such notice must be accompanied by a notice
signed by the person proposed indicating his willingness to be elected.
